description: Same 12 common categories; domain conditions append contextual explanations only. These are research prompt designs, not validated professional taxonomies.

semiconductor_work.actor: Responsibility across engineers, reviewers, coordinators and external collaborators.
semiconductor_work.system: Tools used for measurements, records, documents and communication.
semiconductor_work.input: Identifiers, requests and prerequisites needed before work starts.
semiconductor_work.output: Evidence, reports and notifications that mark progress or completion.
semiconductor_work.decision: Criteria for proceeding, revising, escalating or accepting a result.
semiconductor_work.exception: Disruptions involving equipment, records, ownership or coordination.
semiconductor_work.dependency: Ordering and handoffs between people, systems or organizations.
semiconductor_work.frequency: How often the work is requested and whether demand varies.
semiconductor_work.manual_effort: Human effort in preparing, checking and communicating work.
semiconductor_work.data_availability: Whether needed records exist and can be reliably accessed.
semiconductor_work.integration_constraint: Interfaces and access boundaries between engineering and office tools.
semiconductor_work.risk_or_approval: Who must authorize actions and what confidentiality limits apply.

childcare.actor: Responsibility shared by parents, other caregivers and childcare staff.
childcare.system: Tools used for household schedules, records and communication.
childcare.input: Plans, permissions and practical prerequisites needed before care coordination starts.
childcare.output: Confirmations, prepared resources and shared information that mark completion.
childcare.decision: Household or provider criteria for proceeding, changing a plan or seeking confirmation.
childcare.exception: Disruptions involving schedules, resources, caregivers or communication.
childcare.dependency: Ordering and handoffs between home, caregivers and childcare providers.
childcare.frequency: How often the routine occurs and whether the schedule varies.
childcare.manual_effort: Human effort in checking, preparing and coordinating household tasks.
childcare.data_availability: Whether needed household or provider information is recorded and accessible.
childcare.integration_constraint: Interfaces and access boundaries between family and provider tools.
childcare.risk_or_approval: Who must confirm changes and what family privacy limits apply.
